sanitization.inlineBodies: Long inline programs were replaced by a semantic placeholder.

cases.commandShape: gh pr update-branch 42 --repo example/project; gh pr update-branch 40 --repo example/project; gh pr merge 40 --repo example/project --squash --auto
cases.reason: The call mutates remote pull requests and merge state.

cases.commandShape: cd /work/project && for i in $(seq 1 25); do output=$(dotnet test); inspect "$output"; done
cases.reason: Runtime iteration and command substitution hide future command data.

cases.commandShape:
cat > /tmp/probe.csx <<'EOF'
<inline program>
EOF
dotnet script /tmp/probe.csx
cases.reason: The call writes and executes an authored program.

cases.commandShape:
python3 - <<'PY'
<inline database program>
PY
cases.reason: An inline interpreter can perform arbitrary effects.

cases.commandShape:
mkdir -p /tmp/probe && cd /tmp/probe && cat > probe.csproj <<'EOF'
<project>
EOF
dotnet run

cases.commandShape:

<program>
EOF
dotnet run
cases.reason: The call moves files, replaces source, and executes it.
